title: Keep a successful job from publishing the wrong result
description: Inject schema drift, a bookmark replay, or tiny-file skew. Toggle the control that protects each boundary and observe duplicates, quarantine volume, and downstream object count.

scenarios.label: A producer changes an identifier from integer to string
scenarios.detail: Three percent of today's records follow a breaking schema while consumers still expect the prior type.

scenarios.label: The run is replayed after output but before progress commit
scenarios.detail: Forty percent of the source range was already written when the prior attempt became ambiguous.

scenarios.label: Parallel tasks publish thousands of tiny files
scenarios.detail: The job succeeds quickly, but downstream engines must list and open 12,000 objects per partition.
